description: This file provides utility functions and types for handling plugin route path contexts and path normalization in a security-conscious manner. It includes functions to normalize prefixes, match paths against prefixes, and resolve path contexts using external functions from security-path.js.

classes.name: PluginRoutePathContext
classes.description: A type representing details about a plugin route path including its normalized forms and validation status.

methods.description: Checks if a pathname matches a given prefix or falls under it.
